title: THE SASSY SEAGULL | Seacrest, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: The Sassy Seagull - A Vacation Rental in The Cottages at Camp CreekFavorite Features- Beach...
description_expanded: The Sassy Seagull - A Vacation Rental in The Cottages at Camp Creek Favorite Features - Beach Views - Large Community Pool / Hot Tub  - Gulf Views - Game Room - Bikes Ocean views! Adorable house on 30A with a centralized location and a short 3 minute walk to the beach. The Sassy Seagull is a beautifully decorated beach cottage in the lovely resort community of Cottages at Camp Creek, located in Seacrest along scenic Hwy 30A. Guests can hang out by the large community pool or soak in the hot tub, or take advantage of the private deeded beach access just a 3-minute walk away. You can also explore the Timpoochee Trail, perfect for walking and jogging or for going for a scenic ride on one of the bikes provided! There's plenty to do here, and you're also in close proximity to restaurants and shopping!   This adorable three-level cottage sleeps 12 people and is the perfect getaway for families! Arriving at The Sassy Seagull, guests are greeted with a vibrant blue beach cottage and four bikes that are perfect for getting around Seacrest. Inside on the first level, guests are welcomed to two king master bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom. The south side master bedroom features a private balcony with patio seating and an ensuite with a soaking tub and spacious shower. Also found on this floor, a closet filled with beach gear to make an unforgettable day at the beach! Beach chairs, boogie boards, and sandcastle tools are all available for guests' enjoyment.  The second level features a wide-open floor plan for the kitchen and living room, making it the perfect environment for the family to gather after an amazing day of fun. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar. Seek comfort in the living room with a large plush sofa and a large flatscreen TV. A second-floor balcony can also be accessed from the living room with double doors that can be fully opened to allow fresh sea air into the home. Lastly, the third bedroom is found on this second level. This bedroom features two queen beds and a large flat-screen TV.  The third and final level of this beach cottage is perfect for kids and gamers alike. There is a large bedroom with a twin-over-twin and twin-over-full bunk. After a day on the beach, complete the night with the enjoyment of the game room. The game room offers family-friendly board games, a flatscreen TV, and a mini-refrigerator. No one on this level will be disappointed by the double doors leading to the top covered balcony featuring the best views of the ocean.  The Cottages at Camp Creek is the perfect community for families. Here, guests will find a neighborhood full of Key-West style cottages that surround the large community pool and hot tub. The Cottages at Camp Creek are located just minutes away from other incredible communities like Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach. Just a 10-minute bike ride away, The Big Chill is conveniently located. The Big Chill is an entertainment district that offers restaurants, shopping, live music, and exciting events-- made for those of all ages.
